Lightbringer Poly Haven assets (Act 2 photoscanned environment)

License: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain, no attribution required). Source: https://polyhaven.com
Downloaded 2026-10-14 through the public API (api.polyhaven.com). Files are unchanged.
Location: Assets/Art/Environment/ActTwo/Photo/

Ground textures (2K diffuse + OpenGL normal):
- burned_ground_01      -> ash ground layer
- brown_mud_dry         -> dried mud road/soil layer
- monastery_stone_floor -> ruined plaza stone

Structure textures (2K diffuse + OpenGL normal, Photo/Materials/Photo*.mat; added 2026-10-14):
- castle_wall_slates -> depot dry-stone walls and the final citadel masonry
- roof_slates_02     -> shed roofs and citadel spires
- weathered_planks   -> sheds, rails, wagons
- bark_brown_02      -> palisade stakes, posts and log stacks

Models (glTF, 1K textures, imported with com.unity.cloud.gltfast):
namaqualand_boulder_02, boulder_01, rock_moss_set_01, dead_tree_trunk, tree_stump_01, dry_branches_medium_01,
wooden_crate_01, wooden_crate_02, wooden_barrels_01, barrel_03, wooden_bucket_01, kite_shield, stone_fire_pit,
large_castle_door (citadel gate), gothic_statue (citadel forecourt)

Prefab wrappers (real-world scale, ground pivot, no colliders) are generated by
Lightbringer > Art > Build Act Two Photoscans (Assets/Scripts/Editor/Environment/ActTwoPhotoSetup.cs).

2026-10-15: namaqualand_boulder_02 replaced rock_face_01 as the cliff/outcrop scan (rock_face_01 is an open-backed
facade and showed a single face when freestanding).
